gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
